headline: Biotechnology and Software Lead Domestic Sectors While Materials and International Markets Display Horizon Divergence
market_regime: Selective Sector Leadership with Horizon-Divergent Broad Momentum
executive_summary: Quantitative evidence reflects strong persistence in domestic Biotechnology (XBI, score 93.96) and Software (IGV, score 89.38), alongside Global Materials (MXI, score 83.57). Broad index breadth and style relationships display mixed-horizon performance, with several tickers registering pending trend changes awaiting the 3-observation confirmation threshold. Risk indicators highlight divergent relative strength across timeframes rather than active sector conflicts.
